title: MeetingAskedData
description: data of meeting.asked (ADR-0028). The convener said something in the room to one attendee (to; the web sends the lead when nobody is selected). actor is the convener, target the addressed agent. The words are in the redacted raw archive (message_ref), never here (MR-12). Turns count 1, 2, ... per room with one turn in flight (MR-04); mode is the person's Quick or Thinking choice for this turn.
